operators.notes: Trivial scan of 5 rows to get the single EUROPE regionkey
Filter 25 nations to 5 European nations. Store as flat array for lookup and n_name retrieval.
Iterate shared supplier hash, keep only European suppliers (~20K). Build a suppkey-keyed hash_map holding all payload columns for output projection.
p_size=15 → 1/50 sel. p_type dict-encoded, check suffix 'BRASS' on dict entries first (~5/150 types). Combined ~1333 qualifying parts. Decode dict for p_type suffix check.

operators.description: For each qualifying partkey, use partsupp_partkey_idx to retrieve its partsupp rows
operators.notes: Dense range index gives (start_row, count) for each partkey. Each part has exactly 4 suppliers at SF10. ~1333 * 4 = 5332 partsupp rows.
Filter partsupp rows to only European suppliers. ~1/5 of 5332 → ~1066 rows. Probe into the european_supplier_set hash_map built in step 3.

operators.description: Compute MIN(ps_supplycost) per p_partkey among European-supplier partsupp rows
operators.notes: Use a direct array indexed by p_partkey storing min_cost (double). Since partkeys are dense integers [1..2M], a 16MB array (2M * 8 bytes) is feasible and gives O(1) lookup. Alternatively, since only ~1333 keys, a compact_hash_map is also fine.

operators.description: Re-scan step 6 output, keep only rows where ps_supplycost = min_cost[p_partkey]
operators.notes: Most partkeys have exactly one European supplier at min cost. Output ~1066 rows (some ties possible). Can be fused with step 6+7 in a two-pass approach: pass 1 computes mins, pass 2 filters.

operators.description: Attach n_name from european_nations array via supplier's s_nationkey
operators.notes: 25-element array indexed by n_nationkey → n_name. O(1) per row.
~1066 rows is tiny. std::partial_sort or full std::sort + take top 100. Single-threaded is sufficient.

parallelism.notes: All intermediate cardinalities are tiny (<6K rows). Part scan (2M rows) is the only sizeable operation but completes in <50ms single-threaded on columnar data. Parallelism overhead would exceed benefit.

notes: Q2 decorrelation strategy: compute the correlated subquery (MIN ps_supplycost per partkey among European suppliers) in a single pass over the index-looked-up partsupp rows, then filter. The shared hash_supplier_by_suppkey avoids a separate supplier scan/build. All cardinalities are small (~1K-5K); the dominant cost is the part table scan (2M rows) and ~1333 random partsupp index lookups.
